title: PLAYER 2 GOES UP WITH HIS KEPT KIT
why: The lift R quick ascent takes the kept kit (RANDOM KIT, BEST KIT, FREEBIE KIT on the map select screen) for player 1, but player 2 went up with MY LOADOUT whenever no kit card was raised for him: when the host lift R started the raid and on every drop in (his own lift R or JOIN THE RAID IN PROGRESS), because the host word only committed his packed list. Proven in a staged player 2 window with BEST KIT and RANDOM KIT kept: the up word filled no kit. Now the up word applies his kept kit when no kit card was raised; a card he answered, or one that timed out on his current kit, still decides as before.
now: In co-op, player 2 now goes up with the kit he picked on the map select screen (RANDOM KIT, BEST KIT or FREEBIE KIT) when player 1 takes the quick ascent or when he drops into a raid in progress.
